data.name: sqlStmtUpdRLAmendedItem
data.value: UPDATE TBL_ITEM SET ITM_FLD12 = @UpdAcctNo, ITM_OriDepositor = ITM_Fld12, ITM_OriChqBSB = CASE WHEN (ITM_ItemType = 'C') THEN ITM_FLD4 ELSE ITM_OriChqBSB END, ITM_FLD4 = @UpdBSB, ITM_TransSeqNum = @TranSeqNo, ITM_FLD7 = CASE WHEN (ITM_ItemType = 'C' and (LTRIM(RTRIM(ITM_FLD4)) <> LTRIM(RTRIM(@UpdBSB)))) THEN '5' ELSE ITM_FLD7 END, ITM_Amount = @UpdAmount WHERE ITM_BusDate = @BusDate AND ITM_BatchDirectory = @BatchDir AND ITM_BatchNum = @BatchNum AND ITM_TransNum = @TransID AND ITM_DIN = @DinNo

data.name: sqlStmtUpdTransactionStatus
data.value: UPDATE TBL_REJECTITEMSTATUS SET REJ_STATUS = @status, REJ_ACTIONEDBY = @OperID , REJ_ACTIONEDTIME = GETDATE() where REJ_Busdate = @CurBusDate and REJ_BATCHNUM = @BatchNum and REJ_TRANSNUM = @TransNo AND REJ_NEW_BUNDLEID = @BundleID AND (REJ_ACTIONEDBY = @OperID OR ((REJ_STATUS = 'W') AND (@status = 'I')))

data.name: sqlStmtGetMaxDinNo

data.name: sqlStmtGetResetItem
data.value: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TBL_REJECTITEMSTATUS (Nolock) WHERE REJ_STATUS = 'W' AND REJ_BUSDATE = @Busdate AND REJ_BATCHNUM = @BatchNum AND REJ_TRANSNUM = @TransNum AND REJ_NEW_BUNDLEID = @NewBundleID

data.name: sqlStmtGetSelectedRejTransactionList
data.value: SELECT CASE WHEN A.REJ_REASON LIKE 'RL%' THEN 'RL' WHEN A.REJ_REASON LIKE 'DI%' THEN 'DI' WHEN A.REJ_REASON LIKE 'REJECT%' THEN 'PV' ELSE '' END AS REJ_CATEGORY, B.ITM_BatchDirectory, A.REJ_BUSDATE, A.REJ_BATCHNUM, A.REJ_TRANSNUM, A.REJ_REJECTBY, A.REJ_REJECTTIME, A.REJ_SITECODE, A.REJ_REASON, A.REJ_ALLOWTOLERANCE, A.REJ_ALLOWBREAKDOWN, A.REJ_STATUS, B.ITM_Fld10, CASE WHEN (len(rtrim(ltrim(B.ITM_ProcMode))) > 1 and B.ITM_ProcMode = '02') THEN 'M' WHEN (len(rtrim(ltrim(B.ITM_ProcMode))) > 1 and B.ITM_ProcMode <> '02') THEN 'C' ELSE B.ITM_ProcMode END as PROC_MODE, A.REJ_ACTIONEDBY, A.REJ_ACTIONEDTIME, A.REJ_DECISION, ISNULL(A.REJ_REMARK,'') AS REJ_REMARK, A.REJ_NEW_BUNDLEID , B.ITM_WsID,A.REJ_1STDECISION,A.REJ_2NDDECISION,A.REJ_ROUTETOFINAL FROM TBL_REJECTITEMSTATUS A(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN (SELECT ITM_ProcMode, ITM_BatchDirectory, ITM_BusDate, ITM_BatchNum, ITM_TransNum, MIN(ITM_FLD10) AS ITM_FLD10, ITM_WsID FROM TBL_ITEM WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ITM_ItemType = 'C' GROUP BY ITM_BusDate, ITM_BatchDirectory, ITM_BatchNum, ITM_TransNum,ITM_ProcMode, ITM_WsID ) B ON (A.REJ_BUSDATE = B.ITM_BUSDATE AND A.REJ_BATCHNUM = B.ITM_BatchNum AND A.REJ_TRANSNUM = B.ITM_TransNum) WHERE REJ_BUSDATE = @Busdate AND REJ_BATCHNUM = @BatchNo AND REJ_TRANSNUM = @TransNo AND REJ_NEW_BUNDLEID = @BundleId AND REJ_SITECODE = @Site
